Welcome.Title: 栖格 · DeskNest Native Desktop Shell
Welcome.Subtitle: A structured desktop paradigm: dual-mode spaces, semantic sorting, and reversible file lifecycles.

Operations.Title: Operation History & Transaction Log
Operations.Subtitle: Inspect persisted file movement and transaction lifecycle states; records reflect Core truthfully with no fake undo
Operations.Empty: No operation records yet. Committed file movements or transactions will be recorded here truthfully.
Operations.DescProposed: Operation proposed by model or rule resolver; no physical file changes executed yet.
Operations.DescPendingUser: Transaction is awaiting explicit user authorization or manual trigger.
Operations.DescCompleted: Physical move transaction successfully executed and synchronized with workspace metadata.
Operations.DescUndone: Physical move transaction successfully undone; file safely restored to its original space and path.
Operations.DescRecoveryRequired: Transaction interrupted or state anomaly detected; system halted in fail-closed safety state.
Operations.RecoveryRequiredAction: [Action Required] Physical commit incomplete or journal corrupted. Inspect the recovery journal in data directory and verify filesystem state before retrying.
Operations.NoUndoNotice: Audit Notice: Operations are an immutable transaction log. Automatic undo and blind reversal are unavailable to prevent data loss; only verified Completed operations expose identity-checked manual undo.
Operations.ManualMoveGatedNotice: Manual move is gated: Core transaction coordinator not attached; direct File.Move is prohibited
Operations.ManualMoveReadyNotice: Core transaction coordinator is attached; controlled manual move is available
Operations.UndoGatedNotice: Manual undo is gated: Core transaction coordinator not attached; direct File.Move is prohibited
Operations.UndoReadyNotice: Core transaction coordinator is attached; controlled manual undo is available
Files.CapabilityManagedDesc: Physical file residing in DeskNest managed storage with journaled transactions and reversible deletion.
Files.CapabilityMappedDesc: External reference pointing to existing directory. Removal only unmaps catalog reference; source file is preserved.
Files.GatedNotice: Action is gated: Injectable executor is not attached; direct filesystem mutations are prohibited
Files.OpenGatedNotice: Open is gated: Platform launcher is not attached
Files.OpenReadyNotice: Platform launcher is attached; open file is ready
Files.PreviewGatedNotice: Preview is gated: Preview host is not attached
Files.PreviewReadyNotice: Preview host is attached; quick preview is ready
Files.CopyGatedNotice: Copy is gated: Clipboard coordinator is not attached
Files.CopyReadyNotice: Clipboard coordinator is attached; copy is ready
Files.CutGatedNotice: Cut is gated: Clipboard coordinator is not attached
Files.CutReadyNotice: Clipboard coordinator is attached; cut is ready
Files.PasteGatedNotice: Paste is gated: Clipboard coordinator is not attached
Files.PasteReadyNotice: Clipboard coordinator is attached; paste is ready
Files.RenameGatedNotice: Rename is gated: Core transaction coordinator not attached
Files.RenameReadyNotice: Core transaction coordinator attached; rename is ready
Files.DeleteGatedNotice: Delete/Remove is gated: Core transaction coordinator not attached
Files.DeleteReadyNotice: Core transaction coordinator attached; delete/remove is ready
